compositions.composition_rule: NavT contributions must be projected through Π_A before contributing to admissible transition structure.
compositions.closure_condition: Π_A(NavT(...)) remains inside the active admissibility domain.
compositions.failure_condition: Projected contribution is empty, unstable, or forbidden.

compositions.composition_rule: The gate evaluates admissibility-projected transition candidates under the active constraint context.
Only admissible transitions may be written into residue through Ψ.
compositions.identity_condition: Residue context identity if no admissible transition occurs.
compositions.closure_condition: Ψ updates R without violating residue-context consistency.
compositions.failure_condition: memoryless update, passive residue agency, or missing admissibility context.

identity_rules.name: empty_projection_identity_v1
identity_rules.statement: If no admissible component survives Π_A, the update contribution is the neutral/no-update contribution for that chain.

identity_rules.name: residue_context_identity_v1
identity_rules.statement: If residue context is unchanged and no admissible transition occurs, Ψ must not create new residue inscription except through explicit decay/saturation rules.
